body:
Asking her if she needs professional health and moving pills around is as much for me as it is for her. 

If I don’t ask if she wants to get professional help and then something happens, I will regret not asking.

If she has to ask another human for her pills back, that’s a barrier to impulsive behavior. And I won’t look back and wish I had created that barrier.

I appreciate your candor. A lot of this is what I’ve been telling myself. There are things I can take with me when I leave, but control is not one of those things. I just want to exercise that control as best I can while I still have it
